_about: The child (Child, scripts/villagers/child.gd; docs/DESIGN.md, ความรักและแต่งงาน -> ลูก). One child per marriage, no gender in the rules. news_after_days: the news comes this many days after the wedding day (flag wedding_day), on the first morning from then that is not a festival day and the spouse's heart band is at least news_band. birth_after_days: the birth comes this many days after the news, on the first morning from then that is not a festival day. stages: by days since the birth, from (a stage runs until the next one starts; the last never ends). hearts: the child's affection under the id child; start_band and min_band are heart bands of Affection.rules().bands, so the child starts at band 3 and never falls below it. look: the child has the spouse's hair style and colour; skin is the middle of the farmer's and the spouse's skin (skin_mix 0.5); clothes are the small indigo happi every child wears. names: three for each spouse, all gender-neutral, made up for this game; the player picks one at the birth. Balance numbers are ours.

cradle._about: The baby's bamboo cradle in the second room (a cradle prop in data/maps/house.json, shown while the stage is baby: the flag child_stage). times: from (HH:MM) until the next row's from, the last running past midnight to the first; look is the picture (asleep, awake, cry) and line what the farmer reads looking in (%s is the child's name). The house's clock stands still indoors, so it is the hour the farmer came in.

times.line: %s is fast asleep, breathing slow and even.
%s is awake before the birds and crying to be fed.
%s is wide awake, waving two small fists at the beams.
%s is napping, one hand curled by one cheek.
%s is awake and kicking at the quilt.
%s watches the lantern light and yawns.

figures._about: How the crawler, the toddler and the child are drawn (Child.figure_key, FigureArt.draw_little): build is the FigureArt body (crawler on hands and knees, toddler and child standing); stride is the cells moved per walk frame (short arms and legs take short steps). styles: the spouse's hair style as the little one wears it (no long hair, headbands, tenugui or straw hats on someone this small: long hair is tied up in a bun). A stage's own styles stand before them: the child grows the spouse's long hair out and wears a headband like them, but still no tenugui or straw hat.

days._about: Where the crawler and the toddler are through the day (Child.plan, shown by Villagers like a villager): per stage a speed (cells per game minute), rules ({if: the conditions of a villager rule, plan}: the first that holds picks the day's plan, else default) and plans in the villager plan format (DayPlan; README.md, Villagers). by_spouse: while the plan and the spouse are both on map `home`, the little one stays at the spouse's side, this many cells off the spouse, turned to them (the crawler on the mat in front of them, the toddler beside them at the kotatsu). A stage with no plans of its own uses the toddler's. The child stage has its own, with times out at the spouse's side (child.with). Ours: the crawler never leaves the house; the toddler plays in the yard by the dog's kennel from 9:00 to 15:45 on dry days and stays in on wet days and festival days; both are in bed from 20:00.

with._about: When the child is out with the spouse (Child.place): plans names the day plans that have a time out together, [from, until): from then, wherever the spouse is (any map but away), the child is at the spouse's side, on the home map at by_spouse's offset, elsewhere at side (sides.<spouse>.<map> for a map of their own; while the spouse stands still and that cell is a wall, a door, a counter or off the map, the first free of tries), turned to them, walking along while they walk. join_at moves the out plan's from for a spouse whose late morning is not a place to join them (Mio poles the ferry until about 10:00). Ours: the child plays in the yard by the kennel from 7:00, walks off by the gate at 9:35, is with the spouse at their work from 10:00 and comes home with them; on a festival day with the spouse all day, home again by 20:30.

help._about: The child's morning help (Child.help, from Game.end_day after the spouse's): at stage `stage`, the child's heart band at least `band`, on a day whose weather is in `weather`, up to `weeds` weeds in the field are pulled (FarmGrid.pull_weeds, row by row from the field's top-left). The spouse waters and feeds; the child only weeds, so the two never do the same chore. The farmer hears it on stepping out, after the spouse's line (messages one / more, %s the child's name, %d how many). Kept as the flag help_weeds for the day, for the child's talk line. Ours: two weeds is a small hand's morning, a nudge and not a hoe's worth; rain, storms and snow keep the child in.

messages.one: %s pulled up a weed in the field this morning.
messages.more: %s pulled up %d weeds in the field this morning.

hold._about: Holding the little one out of the cradle (BabyActions, Child.carried): the tool button facing them lifts them into the hold pose at the stages listed; either button sets them down on the free cell in front, or back where they were lifted when that cell is taken. Never thrown, never left as an item. Set down, they sit there stay_minutes of the clock (the house's clock stands still, so until the farmer leaves the room), then their day plan has them again. Doors wait while they are held; a map change, the night and a load put them back to the plan's place. Ours: only the crawler is small enough to carry about; the toddler walks by themselves.

gifts._about: What the little one thinks of a gift (Villagers.reaction, as a villager's gifts): sweets and wild berries are the best, bitter and hot things the worst. Gifts are taken from the stage gifts_from on (the crawler only babbles). Ours.
